GAUTAM BUDDHA UNIVERSITY

DEPARTMENT OF ARCHITECTURE & PLANNING
=================================================================
Advertisement
Walk in Interview for Project Associate in Department of Architecture & Planning.
Applications are invited for the post of Project Associate for appointment on temporary basis
within two weeks of the advertisement:
Name of Post : Project Associate
Position : 02
Qualification : B. Planning/ B.Tech. (Civil)/ B.Arch.&Master of Planning
Monthly Salary : Rs 60,000/- (inclusive All)
Project Duration : 12 Month
Experience : one year or more experience working in GIS, Report Writing,
Primary & Secondary Data Collection Mapping
*Interviews will be conducted Offline Mode.
*Position can be cancelled any time with one month notice.
*Interested candidates may submit their application along with their CV on email:
nirmitam@gbu.ac.in sand make themselves appear for interview.
(Dr. Nirmita Mehrotra)
Head of Department
Department of Architecture & Planning (SOE)
